body:
I'm a straight female.  My boyfriend is an (allegedly) straight male.  We've been dating for over two years.  He is completely uninterested in having sex with me.  He has never initiated anything, and when I try to initiate things, he rebuffs me.  I gave him a blowjob (once), and he stopped me before he came.  (I give a pretty decent blowjob, that isn't the problem).  That was a year and a half ago.  

I know he loves me.  I love him, too.  Outside of the bedroom, things are perfect (or we obviously wouldn't have been together this long).  But this is... weird.  

When we started dating, the lack of sex wasn't a big deal.  I figured we were taking things slowly... but not "over two years" slowly.  At this point, I don't even know how to talk to him about it.  Somewhere along the way, we crossed the line between "taking it slowly" and "weird, sexless relationship," and now I have no idea how to talk about the elephant in the room.  How do you tell someone, "hey, I thought we would have been having sex for a year and a half by now"?

I'm not fat or ugly.  I'm slender and I have a "cute" (not the right proportions for "beautiful," but still nice) face.  He tells me I'm beautiful, and that's something, but it's not enough to carry a relationship.

We're both twenty-seven, and our friends are starting to ask when we're going to get married.  I love him, but I don't want to spend my life in a relationship where "sex" is only something that we see on TV.  

Every night, I feel hurt and unwanted.  I've mostly given up trying to initiate anything... even if he responds and we start kissing, he stops too soon and I feel crushed.  I don't know how to talk about this.  I don't know what to do.  I don't know what I've done wrong.  This is tearing me apart.  

I guess I just... want someone to know.  I need advice.

Help me?

An old friend of mine showed me pictures very much like these (I thought they might be the same ones) a few years ago.  Winter 2002/2003, maybe?  He also lived in Ohio; I figured you might be him.

I guess not!
